kind: synthetic exact mechanism experiment, not empirical competition evidence
hypothesis: Uncertain positive-set size and crop quality can make marginal highlight ranking and a ratio-of-expectations budget decoder disagree with the Bayes action for expected per-video joint F.
counter_hypothesis: If M is known, unweighted marginal expected joint utility is sufficient for every fixed K; if perfect equal crops and conditionally independent Bernoulli labels hold, marginal highlight ordering remains correct even though K selection can fail.
predefined_examples: four frames: probability 3/5 of labels 1110, probability 2/5 of labels 0001, perfect crops
two independent Bernoulli frames with p=(9/10,2/5), perfect crops
four frames: probability 13/20 of labels 1111 and crop-left, probability 7/20 of labels 1000 and crop-right
primary_validation: Finite-posterior analytical decoder equals independent enumeration of all legal subsets and candidate crops exactly, using rational arithmetic.
independent_unit: A synthetic finite posterior, not a video or observed frame.
effect_gate: An exact inequality refutes universal equivalence; it says nothing about empirical effect size.
coverage: Known-M, unknown-M, spatial-utility, empty-set, marginal/add-delete and macro-average edge cases.
resources: CPU only, no downloads, no official-test inputs, planned <20 minutes.
stopping_rule: Stop on any equality assertion failure; do not select examples based on competition scores.
limitation: Posterior supplied by construction. Its estimability, calibration and transfer are not established. Official evaluator version remains unavailable. Empty-empty=1 follows 01, not a newly executed official evaluator.
